description: Capability for the rrcloud sync plugin (ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§7) — only loaded when the `sync` Cargo feature links `tauri-plugin-rrcloud` (see build.rs's feature-conditional `capabilities_path_pattern`); a `--no-default-features` build never reads this file. The http scope lets the dock panel download dock firmware releases (src/components/panel/sync/DockFirmware.tsx) to send them over Bluetooth.
